name: Butts Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single residence with a multi-gable gray shingle roof on a corner lot of a residential cul-de-sac|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house and provides parking space|Mature trees stand along the rear and left side of the lot|A fence divides the front and back yards|Neighboring homes sit close on adjacent parcels|Open lawn occupies portions of the rear and right side.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a multi-gable gray shingle roof with an attached garage and a paved driveway leading from the street|A covered entry with steps sits near the center of the facade and a sidewalk leads to it from the driveway|Shrubs and small landscaped beds sit between the driveway and the house|Neighboring homes are visible on both sides.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the multi-gable roof and light-colored walls|A paved driveway and parking area run along this side|Mature trees stand along the back left edge of the lot|A fence extends from the house to the perimeter fence, separating the front and back yards|A neighboring house sits close on the right of the frame.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the multi-gable gray shingle roof and a covered rear patio or deck area|Dense mature trees fill the lower portion of the frame and limit the view of the ground immediately behind the house|A neighboring structure is partially visible to the right.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation with windows, a multi-gable roof, and a small upper-deck|A paved driveway and parking area sit to the left of the house|Lawn and mature trees occupy the right edge of the lot|A fence extends from the house to the perimeter fencing, separating the front and back yards|Neighboring roofs are visible in the foreground and background.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Brighton Cir to the front garage. The house is a single-family residence in a residential neighborhood with neighboring homes close on several sides. Mature trees stand along the rear and left side and may limit sightlines and movement in those areas. A fence extending from the house on both sides separates the front and back yards but no gates are visible in the available imagery.
clarifications: Is the driveway a through route or does it terminate at the garage and side parking? Is there a usable path around the rear of the house through the trees? Are there additional entries on the rear or sides that are not clearly visible?
